about.title: About
about.subtitle: Learn more about Home Account
about.description: A personal finance management application built with modern web technologies. Track your income, expenses, budgets, and gain insights into your financial habits.
about.privacyBody: Transactions, receipts and notes are stored in your own account and are never sold or shared. Anonymous usage statistics are included in the free plan: only screens and features are recorded — never amounts, merchants, categories or anything you typed. Premium accounts can turn them off in Settings.
about.donateDescription: If you find this app helpful, consider supporting its development with a donation. Your contribution helps maintain and improve the application.
